title: Fans jubilate as France sends Sweden home after 3-0 win and Mbappé brace
summary: France have booked their place in the World Cup Last 16 after a 3-0 win over Sweden. Kylian Mbappe scored two more goals giving him six so far this tournament. It was the first match back for coach Didier Deschamps after his mother's funeral and saw the whole French team unite with him as they go through the next round.
